verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only lists "Appointment booking pages" as a feature and describes generic event and API primitives. Nothing documents invitees rescheduling or cancelling from a booking confirmation, any enforcement of founder-defined reschedule or cancel policies, or propagation of those changes across calendars. Booking pages and API building blocks are adjacent to this story, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a founder, invitees can reschedule or cancel from their confirmation, with my policies enforced and calendars updated everywhere
